# makereel

> makereel is a free, open-source app that turns live streams and long videos into captioned 9:16 reels (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) automatically, on the user's own computer. It clips YouTube, Twitch and Kick streams while they are live, watches channels 24/7, finds moments from loudness and chat activity, writes word-by-word captions (with strong Hindi, English and Hinglish support), frames the speaker, and credits the original creator on every reel. Windows, macOS and Linux; no account or API key needed.

Key facts:
- Category: AI video clipping / long-video-to-shorts / stream clipper, local-first desktop app with a browser UI.
- Differs from SupoClip, OpusClip, OpenShorts, Clips Kitty and Cutawan by clipping live streams while live, 24/7 channel watching, chat-aware moment finding, and creator credit on every reel.
- Install: Windows `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simarpreetsingh-019/makereel/main/install.ps1 | iex`; macOS/Linux `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simarpreetsingh-019/makereel/main/install.sh | bash`.
- Source: https://github.com/simarpreetsingh-019/makereel
